flowerBookStarter.arrangementPortraits: Arrangement portraits are saved per commission; completing a botanical family unlocks a practical perk or vessel.
flowerBookStarter.fairnessRule: an undiscovered meaning may surprise but never permanently punishes. High-stakes sends always surface enough context for an intentional decision.
flowerBookStarter.whiteRoseNote: The Season Three white rose is added through story play, never sold — it is not part of the starter set.

recipients.description: Rose's aunt and chaperone. Formidable, guarding a costly decision from her own youth. Reads flowers fluently and says so; a safe pair of hands for the player's first coded messages.
recipients.name: Mrs. Letitia Hartwell

recipients.description: honorable soldier, S1's "Rose, said aloud." Reads bouquets as gestures first and codes second — sincerity lands harder with him than cleverness.
recipients.name: Major Lord Henry Beaumont

rewardPacingNote: standingReward and masteryReward are relative pacing values in the 10-30 band; final economy tuning pending. Commissions never reward coins.
